title: Crediting Rule Card: Accumulation Interest Rate on Whole Life Insurance Policies Drawing Loans
content:
**Whole Life Insurance (Ashgrove) — rate credited on dividend accumulations.**

**Rule.** The rate credited is lowered for a policy drawing loans, judged by the loan advances on the policy ledger, owner loans and automatic premium loans alike, dated within the 24 calendar months before the day the credit is processed: by **1 percentage point (0.01)** where there are two or more, by **0.50 percentage point (0.005)** where there is exactly one, and not at all where there is none.

**What counts.** Every loan advance entry, whether advanced on the owner's request or as an automatic premium loan. Capitalized interest and repayments are not advances.

**Window.** A loan advance dated later than the same day of the month twenty-four months before the processing day is inside; one dated on that day or earlier is outside.

**Card examples (hypothetical, credit processed June 2, 2026, declared rate 3.75%).**

- Automatic premium loans of September 5, 2025 and December 5, 2025: two advances, rate 2.75%.
- One owner loan of July 1, 2024: one advance, rate 3.25%.
- One owner loan of June 2, 2024: exactly twenty-four months earlier, outside; rate not lowered.
